digest.component_or_area: LLM usage log / PydanticAIRunner failure path
propositions: A failed LLM call writes no usage row because record() runs after run()'s except spine, which always re-raises via interpret_failure.
JSONL spend totals folded by summarize() silently under-report actual spend by exactly the failed calls, affecting billable CI job summaries.
Per-step attribution cannot see failed calls, so expensive retry-to-exhaustion failures are invisible to operators.
A failed call must write a distinguishable usage row carrying identifying fields (op, step, model_class, model, provider) plus known token counters, marked explicitly as failed.
Telemetry on the failure path must never convert or swallow the provider's original exception, preserving the existing OSError-swallowing discipline.
A call that fails and is then retried must not be double-counted as delivered work; one row per run() call with outcome markers separates burned budget from delivered work.
